Class Learner

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.rl.Learner
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class Learner extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Ties the networks, the rollout buffer and PPO together.

Threading contract: act(Obs, int, boolean, boolean, int[]), complete(float, boolean, boolean, Obs) and value(Obs) are called from the game thread; update(boolean) runs on a trainer thread. The caller must not act while an update is in flight, except through actStandIn(Obs, int, boolean, int[]), which plays a copy the update does not touch.

    • reopenHead

      public void reopenHead(int head, float restBias)
      Puts one head back to how a head is when it is first unlocked: the trunk has no say in it yet, and it rests on its default with the given strength. For a control whose earlier training taught it one thing only (never to be used) and which now has something else to learn. Not while an update is running.

    • interrupt

      public void interrupt()
      The episode was cut off before the pending step could be scored (pause, stop, lost opponent). The last stored step becomes the end of its episode, bootstrapped from the value of the observation that followed it, so advantages never run across the gap.

    • takeEpisodePotential

      public float takeEpisodePotential()
      How much the episode just ended had to teach, as prioritised level replay (Jiang et al., ICML 2021) scores a level: the mean |GAE| over its recorded steps. NaN when none were recorded. Starts the next episode's count.

    • clearEpisodePotential

      public void clearEpisodePotential()
      Forgets the TD errors kept so far; at the start of an episode.
